sutta: 5.8 and under sutta thus have I heard at one time the Lord was staying near rajagaha and the bamboo wood at the squirrel's feeding place at that time on the day of the upusata observance remember Ananda addressed in the four noon took his bowl and outer cloak and entered rajagaha for arms food River data saw the member Ananda walking for arms food in rajagaha and on seeing him approach the Venable Ananda and said from today friend Ananda I shall keep the upusata observance and then and enact the business of the Sangha apart from the Lord and apart from the Sangha of monks having walked in Raja kaha for arms food and returned after the meal approached the Lord frustrated himself sat down to one side and said to the Lord revealed sir had dressed in the full moon Taking My Ball and outer claw and entered Raja kaha for arms food River data saw me and said from today I shall keep the upusata observance etc etc apart from the Sangha of monks today revered sir Deva data will divide the Sangha he will keep the upusata observance at night the business of the Sangha separately stop here for a moment this is David Atta he split the sanghana is what is called the Schism of the Sangha he set up his own sangala and this is a very serious thing to do and something that can bring one definitely to hell when he dies so because of his ego he wanted to lead the Sangha and the Buddha did not allow him to lead the Sangha he still insists on leading his own sanghal they are realizing his significance the Lord acted on that occasion this inspired utterance for the good to do what is good is easy for the bad to do what is good is difficult for the bad to do what is bad is easy for the noble to do what is bad is difficult so the Buddha said this devadata has not a spot of goodness in him he will never see the Buddha again after trying to kill the Buddha and all that
